A synthetic 0.000001 mm contact reproduces the false positive; deep and 0.001 mm penetrations are correctly rejected.
c4-local-shared-edge-contact-probe.json: Actual shared-edge adjacency resolves sharp-edge contacts using the unchanged 2e-5 mm tolerance. Raw 349/contact349/transverse0; 104 contacts need actual adjacent-face evidence. Largest local plane deviation is 2.294e-6 mm. All 42 actual targets have positive ray controls. Deep and 0.001 mm penetrating closed meshes remain rejected. A later final test additionally requires the adjacent clipped footprint to lie within 2e-5 mm of the specific hit, not another location along the extended edge.
